name: Broker can switch offer payment frequency and the selection persists
description:
Objective: Broker can switch offer payment frequency and the selection persists.
Preconditions: Open Offer review with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Offer review.
2. Broker can switch offer payment frequency and the selection persists.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Exercise the interaction behind the Daily/Weekly controls.
